notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator and Fiend Artisan do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fiend Artisan by paying {2}{B/G} and sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it onto the battlefield.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat each turn.
